toolArgumentsForFutureRootApprovedGenera.prompt:
Create a brand-new TRUE RGBA transparent native sprite atlas for the CQC browser fighting game. Do not edit any existing generated atlas. The attached original game references guide silhouette and original palette, not invented fine detail.
Adult RED BLASTER from ORIGINAL 1990 MSX2 Metal Gear 2. Match original RED-B tiny sprite and game captures: GREEN compact human body with dark/ochre extremities, not a literal red uniform. No Fatman rollers, bomber suit, remote C4 vest or generic pistol. Grenades and crossed immobilizing wire are original abilities. Exact launcher model, grenade model and costume seams are unresolved. This native atlas uses a visibly small restrained grenade/canister hand-release representation and hand placement for wire as an EXPLICIT VERSUS ADAPTATION, not a canonical exact launcher reproduction. Do not invent a named launcher or certify its shape. Keep exact face and equipment details understated.
Produce sheet A_RIGHT, exactly twelve COMPLETE separate full-body poses, ALL facing anatomically RIGHT. Author this orientation independently, never mirror a previous atlas. Every toe, sole, hand and held weapon must remain within its own cell with ample empty transparent margin. Maintain identical character scale and costume across all 12 poses. Native landscape atlas with FOUR columns and THREE rows, read left to right then top to bottom. No text, cell borders, labels, grey matte, checkerboard image background, shadow floor, stage, watermark, detached effects, spare heads or extra mini bodies. Leave clear separation between all 12 connected actor silhouettes. Any held equipment must stay connected to the hands/body. Do not paint projectiles, explosions, flying stars, detached tripwires or muzzle flashes. Full opacity for actual cloth/body/gear; true alpha 0 outside actor. These are native source images and must never be cleaned, scaled or pixel-edited after generation.
Four triplets, numbered 0–11 in this exact order: 0,1,2=idle: calm full-body ready stance, first/second/third small independent motion; 3,4,5=walk: full-body forward walking step, alternate weight then planted step; 6,7,8=guard: adapted unarmed/body guard preparation, held guard then recovery; 9,10,11=crouch: lowering, held full-body crouch, rising.
Render a crisp polished 2D sprite style grounded in the tiny original 1990 silhouette/palette. Do not claim invented anatomical detail, textures, balance actions or hardware is official 1:1. Aim for the nearest supported reconstruction, retain unknown details unobtrusively, and keep every complete pose suitable for independent native source cropping and foot-pivot measurement.
